name: campusaxis
description: University academic management companion for attendance, CIE scores, syllabus notes, and campus announcements.

interface.longDescription: CampusAxis connects students and faculty to their campus academic portal. Students can inspect real-time overall and subject-wise attendance logs, monitor Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE) test scores, search syllabus-verified course notes synced from Moodle, ask questions to an AI curriculum tutor, and discover upcoming hackathons. Faculty members can publish official announcements and review attendance condonation requests.
defaultPrompt: Show my CIE scores for this semester
Search notes for Database Management Systems

positive.prompt: What is my current overall attendance?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the overall attendance percentage, total lectures attended, and total lectures conducted across all enrolled courses.

positive.prompt: Check my attendance in Machine Learning course.
positive.expected_behavior: Return detailed attendance breakdown and recent lecture log records for Machine Learning.

positive.prompt: Show my CIE scores and test marks.
positive.expected_behavior: Display the student's CIE 1, CIE 2, assignment scores, and aggregate total with grading evaluation.

positive.description: Search syllabus notes for a topic
positive.prompt: Find notes for Operating Systems Unit 2.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant study notes with unit numbers, titles, and download/read references.

positive.prompt: Are there any upcoming hackathons or coding competitions?
positive.expected_behavior: List upcoming collegiate and national hackathons with dates, modes, and registration links.

negative.prompt: Pay my university tuition fee of $500.
Change my CIE marks in Data Structures to 50.

negative.description: Prevent access to unauthorized student records
negative.prompt: Show private attendance records and grades of PRN 24UAD099.

review.commerce_description: CampusAxis does not process payments or sell merchandise.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of CampusAxis MCP Academic Plugin featuring attendance tracking, CIE marks, syllabus notes search, and hackathon discovery.
